title: Comparison Measurements Against an Earlier Network Structural Repair (Repair Estimates & Appointments)
content:
**Standard.** On a Repair Estimates & Appointments booking, the measurement base follows the vehicle's earlier structural measurement on file, read from the vehicle's closed network repair order under Insurance Claim Repairs — its repair class and the date it was delivered:

1. For a vehicle whose closed network insurance claim repair order was a Structural Claim Repair, a Certified Structural Claim Repair or an Aluminum Certified Structural Claim Repair delivered fewer than **36** whole months before the estimate written date, the new report is a comparison against that repair's measurement and the base is the estimate type's structural measurement fee times **0.6** (60%) plus **90.00 USD** for the comparison report.
2. For a vehicle whose such repair was delivered **36** or more whole months before, the base is a fresh measurement at the estimate type's structural measurement fee plus **35.00 USD** for retrieving the archived report.
3. For every other vehicle the base is not set by this standard.

**Structural measurement fee by estimate type, and the resulting bases**

| Estimate type | Structural measurement fee | Comparison base | Fresh measurement with archive retrieval |
|---|---|---|---|
| Photo Estimate | 0.00 USD | — | — |
| Drive-In Estimate | 0.00 USD | — | — |
| Scheduled Estimate | 0.00 USD | — | — |
| Mobile Estimate | 0.00 USD | — | — |
| Blueprint Teardown Estimate | 0.00 USD | — | — |
| Structural Blueprint Estimate | 145.00 USD | 145.00 USD times 0.6 is 87.00 USD, plus 90.00 USD: 177.00 USD | 145.00 USD plus 35.00 USD: 180.00 USD |

**Both sides of the 36-month line** (hypothetical vehicles, estimate written on 10 September)

- Certified Structural Claim Repair delivered 35 whole months before: comparison base, 177.00 USD on a Structural Blueprint Estimate.
- Structural Claim Repair delivered exactly 36 whole months before: 36 or more, so fresh measurement plus archive retrieval, 180.00 USD.
- Standard Claim Repair delivered 12 months before: not a structural class; the base is not set by this standard.
